page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8is.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance configured under the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA L20 GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, which includes 48 GB of dedicated VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Given the combination of dedicated Intel Xeon processing cores, a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, and a professional-grade NVIDIA L20 GPU, this server is designed for workloads requiring GPU acceleration and moderate memory capacity. Suitable workloads include machine learning inference, data science tasks, rendering, and GPU-accelerated database operations.
